description: Case-insensitive root/dummy option matching independently reproduced with the exact Betaflight App 2026.6.2 parser. This fixture extends no firmware-version claim. Display labels stay unchanged; case-only duplicate definitions remain invalid SIM input.

sources.evidence: removeUncheckedOptions lowercases the checked names and each option name before matching; readPresetProperties preserves display labels and checked defaults.
Exclusive groups render radio controls sharing a group name, selecting at most one option. The SIM rejects an invalid multi-selection atomically.

files.presets/root.txt:
#$ TITLE: Case matching regression
#$ FIRMWARE_VERSION: 2026.6
#$ CATEGORY: RATES
#$ STATUS: EXPERIMENTAL
#$ OPTION_GROUP BEGIN: (EXCLUSIVE) Feel
#$ OPTION BEGIN (CHECKED): Race rates
#$ OPTION END
#$ OPTION BEGIN (UNCHECKED): Smooth rates
#$ OPTION END
#$ OPTION_GROUP END
#$ INCLUDE: presets/included.txt
files.presets/included.txt:
#$ OPTION BEGIN (UNCHECKED): RACE RATES
set roll_srate = 90
#$ OPTION END
#$ OPTION BEGIN (CHECKED): SMOOTH RATES
set roll_srate = 80
#$ OPTION END

observations.name: root checked default controls differently cased included option
explicit root selection overrides both included defaults
all unchecked keeps included checked defaults inactive
